ἄγω,
[in LXX for בּוא hi., לקח, נהג, etc. ;]
__1. to lead, bring, carry: with ace, before ἐπί, εἰς, ἕως, πρός and simple dative; metaphorically, to lead, guide, impel: Jhn.10:16 Rom.2:4, Heb.2:10, 2Ti.3:6, al.
__2. to spend or keep a day: Luk.24:21, Act.19:38
__3. Intrans., to go: subjunc., ἄγωμεν, Mat.2:46, al. (Cramer, 61; MM, VGT, see word).

strongs.def: properly, to lead; by implication, to bring, drive, (reflexively) go, (specially) pass (time), or (figuratively) induce
strongs.kjv: be, bring (forth), carry, (let) go, keep, lead away, be open
